crossRefs.note: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the…
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can…
“But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way…
Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed…
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

translations.web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
translations.bsb: Still, their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
translations.kjv: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far
translations.asv: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
